name: Spinning wheel
description: A Saxony spinning wheel about 1.1 m high: a plank bench at stool height on three splayed legs, a spoked wheel between two turned uprights driven by a treadle and footman rod, a drive band to the flyer and a bobbin of yarn between two maidens, and a distaff dressed with a cone of raw wool tied with a red ribbon.

provenance.prompt: A spinning wheel with a distaff of wool and a stool-height bench, about 1 × 0.5 × 1.1 m.
